- Model consistently underestimates prices in the early part of the 30-day horizon, especially after recent spikes.
- Model overestimates prices in the final 5–10 days of the forecast, particularly when true values show sharp downward or sideways correction.
- Model exhibits lag in responding to recent price spikes — forecasts lag behind true price movements by 3–7 days.
- Model tends to overreact to short-term volatility, producing exaggerated peaks after minor price surges.
- Mean reversion is underemphasized — model fails to anticipate and correct for strong upward momentum that persists beyond 10 days.
- Forecasts are overly conservative in low-volatility periods, failing to capture potential upward surprises.
- Model shows persistent bias toward lower values in the first 10 days of the forecast, especially when historical mean is rising.
- Model does not adequately adjust for seasonal or calendar-driven price patterns (e.g., end-of-month or quarter-end spikes).
